title: pure function: parse a board label back into a cell
brief: Add and export `parseBoardCoordinate(label: string): Coordinate | null` to src/game/placement.ts. It is the inverse of the existing `formatBoardCoordinate`: 'A1' is { row: 0, col: 0 } and 'C4' is { row: 3, col: 2 }. Accept upper and lower case letters. Return null for anything that is not one letter for a column of the board followed by one digit for a row of the board (for example '', 'A', 'A0', 'A9', 'I1', '11', 'A10'). Keep the change small and run the project's tests when you are done.
